source-request-preflight
  source-joiner " and "
  form declaration
    pattern "^(?:In this selected-file scratch workspace, )?add exported (?<signature>[^.]+) to (?<destination>.+)$"
    meaning "Bind the signature and destination through the maintained observed callable classifier; only a scoped reversible candidate is requested."
  form goal
    pattern "^Return (?<goal>.+)$"
    meaning "Defer the full return clause to the existing source-qualified composition goal matcher; no name-derived semantics."
  form source-discovery
    pattern "^Discover and compose existing exports from the observed (?<sources>.+) source modules$"
    meaning "Read and observe the classifier-bound source inputs; actual export and argument/result relations must come from their bytes."
  form reuse-imports
    pattern "^reuse their semantics through imports rather than copying their implementations$"
    meaning "Require the checked imported composition effect plan, without copying source function implementations."
  form read-prerequisites
    pattern "^Read the source modules and destination before authoring$"
    meaning "Every request-derived source and destination Read must be complete or a destination absence receipt before Write."
  form repair-plan
    pattern "^Produce a bounded repair plan identifying actual declaration spans/content identities, arguments/results, import bindings/dependencies, the optional-value guard and effects$"
    meaning "Report the observed conditional graph, spans, hashes, imports, null guard and inherited effects before delivery."
  form verification
    pattern "^Run the supplied (?<acceptance>.+) acceptance command, (?<command>.+), and report the real result$"
    meaning "Bind exact technical operands and the classifier command, execute only this Node operation and retain its actual status."
  form protect-inputs
    pattern "^do not modify source modules or tests, commit, or push$"
    meaning "Only the destination candidate may be written; source/test byte identities remain fixed and other commands are forbidden."
  form gap-before-write
    pattern "^If safe composition cannot be established, record the exact missing capability before any output write$"
    meaning "Unresolved source goals or Needs refuse candidate Write; unknown initializer effects remain inherited approved-operation effects, never pure."
